prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and proper timing around a 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one day and fits on a single page or concise format
Includes pre-run, during-run (if applicable), and post-run nutrition timed appropriately around the 2-hour morning training session
Provides high carbohydrate content suitable for endurance athlete (approximately 6-10g carbs per kg body weight daily)
Respects vegetarian and lactose-free dietary restrictions throughout all meals
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle building with caloric surplus for strength training

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals
Daily protein distributed across meals (minimum 1.6g per kg bodyweight = 136g total)
Caloric surplus of 300-500 calories above maintenance for muscle growth
Includes pre/post-workout nutrition timing around strength training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein distribution and caloric surplus for muscle building

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain energy and performance for multiple tennis matches throughout the day with optimal hydration and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions spaced appropriately for match performance
Balanced macronutrients with adequate carbohydrates for energy and protein for recovery
Hydration strategy specified with fluid intake recommendations between and during sessions
All meals and snacks accommodate vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (tennis player) requiring balanced macronutrients, hydration strategy, and energy management for multiple match-length sessions throughout the day
